summary: Focused implementing-agent review, not independent. UI-only unified tooltip manager migrates native titles, uses textContent and retains scoped accessibility descriptions. Rich previews are excluded to avoid duplicate hints. Focused browser checks static/dynamic title migration, light styles, summary exclusion, keyboard focus/Escape, dynamic removal and viewport wrapping. 32 allowlisted packaged files; no GUS/AI data changes. Golden 3.0.0 tags/dataset unchanged.
caveats: No live signed-in hosted browser test. This controls app-owned hints, not browser chrome or operating-system UI.
Unrelated Node/full suite skipped for the reversible UI change.
